This might make you more concerned about second guessing and waiting until most things have fallen into place, becoming one of the reasons you are uncomfortable in new and unfamiliar situations.

Overall, your comfort level in new and unfamiliar situations suggests that you value stability and predictability. However, it's also possible to use this discomfort as a sign to step out of your comfort zone and confront what's making you uncomfortable.
